rawContent: I was 18 when I reported being sexually assaulted.  I lived by myself in a town with a pop. of 1200. I was mocked, my bro didn't believe me b/c he was a friend & my dad continued to employ the perp. My house was vandalized & calling the cops did nothing. #CancelKavanaugh #metoo

Breaking news:  the man that assaulted me when we were both 17 is still an abuser now that we are both in our 30's. Coming forward then didn't do any justice for myself and that's why I fight now for others.  #MeToo #CancelKavanaugh #IBelieveChristine
